### 1) What is on the screen
One paragraph: the frame is a character roster / select mockup on solid black. Top text row names four standing chibi figures below it, second text row names three more slots, with two blue figures and one tall grey statue below. The eye goes first to the top row of four colorful portraits in region x,y,w,h = 22,66,224,42, because they are the only saturated color on 82.4% black. What the player is being asked to do I cannot see - there is no cursor, no prompt, no PRESS START, no stats, no background, no game in motion.

### 2) Does it look like a real NES game
(a) PASS - palette count reads as NES: 11 distinct colours, all measured as valid 64-entry NES palette, well inside the 25 colours on screen ceiling of 12 background + 12 sprite + 1 backdrop.
(b) PASS - shading is flat, one colour per shape, no gradient banding visible on figures or text.
(c) PASS - sprites read against the $0F black backdrop with hard silhouettes; white/blue/orange separate cleanly, no muddy shared colours.
(d) PASS - no anti-aliasing and no soft edges anywhere; text and figures are hard 1px stair-steps.
(e) PASS - background is a single backdrop colour, so trivially no 16x16 pixel attribute drift; no background colour change to violate the background can change palette only on a 16x16 boundary rule. Measured numbers do not contradict this - 11 colours and all-NES matches the handmade impression.

### 3) Composition and text
Crowded top band x,y,w,h = 10,30,236,88 with 4 labels + 4 sprites jammed together, then a second thin band x,y,w,h = 10,134,146,74. Empty everywhere else: x,y,w,h = 190,150,66,90 bottom-right void and x,y,w,h = 0,210,256,30 bottom strip are pure black, which is why one colour is 82.4% of the frame. No focal hierarchy - no cursor, no highlighted choice, so the focal point is not where the player needs it. Text regions: [22,32,34,8] ZEUS, [78,32,48,8] KRONOS, [138,32,40,8] PERCY, [204,32,40,8] MAN 1, [10,134,44,8] MAN 2, [74,134,44,8] MAN 3, [138,134,56,8] OURANOS - all legible at 256x240 in 8x8 white on black without guessing. Worst is [204,32,40,8] MAN 1 and its brothers MAN 2 / MAN 3: legible but double-spaced placeholder names, off-center over their sprites, breaking fiction and reading as debug, not shipped copy. I cannot see scrolling, animation, or gameplay context.

### 4) What looks AI generated or off
Handmade and honest pixeling, not AI gradient mush - no pillow shading, no gibberish glyphs, no soft borders. What is off is design, bluntly:
- placeholder prompt composition: ZEUS / KRONOS / PERCY / OURANOS mixed with MAN 1 / MAN 2 / MAN 3 reads as a prompt list, not a designed party.
- inconsistent structure: OURANOS grey statue in x,y,w,h = 152,144,32,64 is ~1.5x taller and narrower than the six chibi roster sprites, different scale, different palette logic.
- text not on a clean tile rhythm: MAN 1 has a wide gap, OURANOS label touches the statue head with 2px clearance.
- 82.4% empty black with no window border, no floor, no frame - a debug viewer, not a shipped NES screen which would fill 256x240 with tiles.

### 5) Five concrete fixes
1. Region 204,30,44,12: erase MAN 1. Redraw text row as ARES centered on 8-pixel tile boundary using only NES $30 white on $0F black, 8x8 glyphs, single space, same baseline y=32 as ZEUS.
2. Region 152,144,32,64: move OURANOS statue down by 8 pixels and left by 8 pixels to x,y,w,h = 144,152,32,56, so head clears OURANOS label by 8px and feet share baseline y=208 with MAN 2 / MAN 3; simplify silhouette to 16x48 block, no single-pixel protrusions.
3. Region 0,208,256,32: replace solid $0F black with tiled floor using 16x16 attribute blocks alternating $0F black and $01 dark blue, plus 8px high $30 white speck row at y=208 to anchor roster and kill the void.
4. Region 88,66,32,40: recolor isolated KRONOS browns - replace NES $07 brown shadow with NES $0F black outline and keep body to NES $27 orange + $30 white only, matching the 3-colour-per-sprite limit and unifying the 4 sprite palettes.
5. Region 16,66,16,42: add 8x8 selection cursor tile in NES $30 white at x,y,w,h = 8,84,8,8 pointing at ZEUS, and add 1px NES $0F black right-side outline to PERCY white sprite in 150,66,40,46 to close silhouette and create a player focal point.

### 6) Scores and machine readable block
nes_authenticity: 8/10 - hardware-legal but empty
readability: 6/10 - legible text, no goal or cursor
charm: 5/10 - honest pixels, debug placeholders, no world
